provenance: Each case's expected records come from the GameMaker HTML5 runner's own move_and_collide (scripts/functions/Function_Movement.js), PerformColTest, Tilemap_InstancePlace, ValidBBoxOverlap, GenerateTileMapUVs (Function_Instance.js), Command_InstancePlace, Instance_SearchLoop, yyInstance.Collision_Instance, yySprite.PreciseCollisionTilemap, PreciseCollision and ColMaskSet, TestFree, mp_linear_step_common and place_empty, run unchanged in Node on this scene, one call per game step, with x and y kept as doubles. move_and_collide's tests of the collision result against 0 (res >= 0 for 'met something', res < 0 for 'free') are read as comparisons with noone: in JavaScript both are false for a tilemap reference, so the runner never stops early when the instance already overlaps a tilemap. The cases where that changes the answer carry the literal JavaScript records as html5_js.
